newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Cricket-Sri Lanka wins toss, bats first v Zimbabwe.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Sri Lanka wins toss, bats first v Zimbabwe.

text.p: Sri Lanka won the toss and elected to bat in their five-day Test match against Zimbabwe in the capital Colombo on Wednesday.

Sri Lanka - Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Roshan Mahanama, Sanath Jayasuriya, Asanka Gurusinha, Aravinda de Silva, Hashan Tillekeratne, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Kumara Dharmasena, Chaminda Vaas, Muthiah Muralitharan, Jayantha Silva.
Zimbabwe - Alistair Campbell (captain), Andy Flower, Grant Flower, Craig Evans, Heath Streak, Paul Strang, Craig Wishart, Mark Dekker, Guy Whittall, Henry Olonga, Andrew Whittall.
